**Stable ID:** `DATA-10.02` · **Record type:** Work Package · **Workstream:** 10 Cross-repository integration

Define links from datasets and benchmarks to T1 model research and T3 knowledge, embedding and retrieval research.

## Deliverables

- Link types and identifiers for T1 and T3 references

## Canonical artifact paths

- `docs/INTEGRATIONS.md`

## Source and evidence requirements

- Each link cites the upstream research path and commit

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Links reference upstream IDs without copying upstream content
- [ ] Evaluated_on links require benchmark version identity
- [ ] Owners of T1 and T3 issues are informed

## Non-goals

- Asserting model performance

## Tasks and subtasks

- [ ] `DATA-10.02.T1` Define links

- [ ] `DATA-10.02.T2` Notify owners
  - [ ] `DATA-10.02.T2.S1` Post the link specification on the owning issues

- Approval must come from someone other than the author of the change and must cover the latest push.
